services.name: Dog Sledding
services.desc: Enodah Kennel was started in 2015 with a mission to provide quality dogsled tours whilst never sacrificing the wellbeing of the dogs. We are a reasonably small kennel with around 35 dogs, ensuring that each of our animals receives all the attention they need year-round. Enodah Kennel is located 15-minutes from Yellowknife in our own secluded section of forest. We train all our dogs to be loose together and we work 12 months of the year training and exercising our pack of sled dogs. We encourage all our guests to interact with the dogs after the tour.
